t: Durable solution repairs minor damage and chips on ceramic (porcelain), enamel and acrylic surfaces. Ideal for bathtubs, washbasins, sinks and cisterns. Supplied in Alpine White colour to blend with most white bathroom and kitchen sanitary surfaces (not food safe - do not use on cooking utensils). Areas of very heavy usage may require further treatment if signs of wear and tear appear. Contents sufficient for up to 5 repairs. Repaired area is heat-resistant to 60°C.
